info.name: Ginsengfood Ops Core API v1 Contract Smoke
info.description: Contract-only Postman collection for selected ops-core v1 APIs. Uses placeholder baseUrl and no secrets.

request.description: Expected contract response: common v1 envelope with sellable or availability data; standard error envelope for 400/401/403/404/409/422/500.

exec: pm.test('Common v1 envelope', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.schemaVersion).to.eql('v1'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('sellable_status_id'); });

pm.test('Public no-leak', function () { const raw = pm.response.text(); ['evidence_refs','resolvedAt','supplier','costing','qc_defect','personnel','audit','formula'].forEach(function (field) { pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(field); }); });
